description: This file defines the CalendarProviderRegistry class which manages registration, discovery, and retrieval of calendar provider types within the SuiteCRM project. It handles loading provider definitions from specified directories, caching, and generating language extension files for calendar source types. It also includes methods to obtain provider instances for specific calendar accounts and checks for provider existence.

classes.name: CalendarProviderRegistry
classes.description: A registry class responsible for discovering, loading, caching, and managing calendar provider types used in SuiteCRM. It facilitates retrieval of providers by source, validation of enabled providers, and creation of provider instances for calendar accounts. It also handles language extension file generation for calendar source type labels.

methods.name: loadProviders
methods.description: Loads calendar provider definitions, utilizing cache if available, and discovers providers from PHP files in designated directories.

methods.name: discoverProviders
methods.description: Discovers and registers calendar provider classes by including provider configuration PHP files from certain directories, validating their structure, and instantiating provider objects.

methods.name: writeCalendarSourceTypesToExtension
methods.description: Writes calendar source types into language extension files for UI dropdowns and configuration, creating necessary directories if they do not exist.

methods.name: getCalendarSourceTypes
methods.description: Returns an array of calendar source types with display names, used for UI elements.

methods.name: findEnabled
methods.description: Filters and returns only enabled calendar providers.

methods.name: getProviderForAccount
methods.description: Creates and returns a provider instance suitable for the specified calendar account.

methods.name: findBySource
methods.description: Finds a provider type by its source identifier if it is enabled.

methods.name: exists
methods.description: Checks whether a provider with the given source exists.

methods.name: getInternalProviderForAccount
methods.description: Returns an internal SuiteCRM calendar provider configured for the provided account.

methods.name: getAuthMethodForSource
methods.description: Retrieves the authentication method used for a given provider source.
